_readme: Claims about jurisdictions outside Mexico that nobody on this project monitors: US tax practice, UK HMRC treatment, EU member-state regimes, Canadian reporting and provincial health rules. These sit apart from facts.json because that registry is keyed by the bare figure and feeds GEO scoring, while numbers like 25% mean something different on unrelated pages. Each claim carries a reviewBy date; npm run facts:review fails once one is overdue and reports claims whose listed files no longer exist. Reviewing means re-reading the primary source and either moving asOf and reviewBy forward or correcting every file listed.

claims.claim: FBAR filing attaches once aggregate foreign account balances exceed USD 10,000 at any moment in the calendar year
The foreign earned income exclusion sits around USD 130,000 per person and is adjusted annually
claims.source: IRC s911; IRS Rev. Proc. annual inflation adjustment

claims.claim: US long-term capital gains are taxed at 15-20% federal plus the 3.8% net investment income tax for most property-scale disposals
Any personal use of IRA-held property by the owner or a disqualified person is a prohibited transaction deeming the entire IRA distributed on January 1 of that year, with a 10% penalty under age 59.5
claims.source: IRC s4975; IRS guidance on prohibited transactions

claims.claim: A 1031 exchange cannot connect US and foreign property; foreign-to-foreign exchanges can qualify
UK CGT on residential property gains is charged at 18% basic and 24% higher rate, computed in sterling at the exchange rates of purchase and sale dates
claims.source: TCGA 1992 as amended; HMRC CGT rates from April 2024

claims.claim: UK inheritance tax reaches the worldwide estate at 40% above the nil-rate band, Mexican property included
The 1994 UK-Mexico double taxation convention relieves by credit: Mexico taxes first as situs state, the UK credits Mexican tax against its own charge
Spanish tax residents must declare foreign real estate above EUR 50,000 on Modelo 720; penalties were softened after the 2022 CJEU ruling but remain
French residents include worldwide real estate in the IFI wealth-tax base with the threshold at EUR 1.3 million
Italian residents pay IVIE at around 1.06% annually on the value of foreign real estate
claims.source: DL 201/2011 Art. 19; rate as raised by the 2024 budget law

claims.claim: Dutch residents are taxed on foreign property under box 3 deemed-return rules regardless of actual rent
claims.source: Wet IB 2001, box 3 regime in transition

claims.claim: Canadian residents report income-earning foreign property costing over CAD 100,000 on T1135; purely personal-use property is excluded
Provincial health plans require physical presence of roughly five to seven months per year depending on province, so a stretched snowbird winter can void coverage
claims.source: Provincial health insurance residency rules (OHIP and peers), compared 2026

claims.claim: Transiting the US requires an ESTA and full immigration clearance with checked luggage even for connecting passengers
claims.source: CBP ESTA requirements for Visa Waiver Program transit
